A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with 27 readable pages including Appendices A–L. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the research content matches throughout; only the first-page arXiv stamp and its version link differ.

before.justification: v2 reports original SST experiments on translation, language modeling, zero-shot NLP, graph tasks and image classification, including results in Tables 1–5 and 24.

after.justification: v3 retains those original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and memory and training-time measurements in the appendices.

M1.justification: The SST procedure in Section 4, Algorithm 2 and Appendix E.1 is identical, including singular-value updates, vector sampling, gradient modification, periodic SVD and optimizer resets.

E1.justification: Both retain the same translation datasets, OpenWebText/C4 language modeling, 16 zero-shot NLP tasks, four graph datasets and MNIST/EMNIST/Fashion MNIST evaluations. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Full-rank training, LoRA, ReLoRA*, GaLore, Dora and Vera retain their membership in the corresponding comparisons, including Appendices G and L.

E3.justification: Model sizes, ranks, training budgets, learning rates, checkpoint selection and evaluation metrics match throughout Section 5 and the appendices. No evaluation protocol is revised or introduced.

E4.justification: The sampling study, component and initialization ablations, rank and training-step analyses, pruning experiments, memory trade-off analyses and singular-value plots are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report three random seeds for graph experiments and image classification, with the same uncertainty-reporting practice in Tables 5 and 24. No statistical procedure or repeated-run information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings match, including the appendix results. For example, Table 2 retains LLaMA-1.3B perplexities of 14.59 for SST and 14.54 for full-rank training in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and equations, Appendix D gradient derivation and Appendix K efficiency-ratio definition are identical. No assumption, proof or mathematical reasoning changes.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about parameter-efficient pre-training, approximation of full-rank training and applicability to Euclidean and hyperbolic networks.

C2.justification: The saddle-point explanation, exploration/exploitation interpretation, hyperbolic overfitting argument, compression interpretation, resource trade-offs and future directions are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details, sampling probabilities, optimizer warmups, hyperparameters, hardware and training-time disclosures match. The code-access information and its link are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix B, the references and the positioning relative to competing methods are identical. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: The marginal arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 10 Jun 2025 to v3 dated 13 Aug 2025. The title, authors, paper wording, section structure and appendices otherwise match exactly.

P2.justification: All eight figures and 25 tables retain their design, captions and placement. Rendered pages 2–27 are identical; the first-page difference is confined to the marginal arXiv stamp.

improvement.justification: v3 reproduces v2's scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility details and presentation, including all appendices. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its version link produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
